channel.title: Match of the Day
channel.desc: Highlights of six Premier League matches, including champions Arsenal against Leeds at the Emirates. Bottom-of-the-table Spurs travel to Manchester United, whilst Chelsea welcome Bournemouth to Stamford Bridge. Elsewhere, Aston Villa host Brentford, third-placed Brighton make the long trip to Sunderland, and Ipswich take on Fulham.
